info.title: Castrook API
info.summary: Customer onboarding, media, publishing, comments and performance in one API.
info.description: Developer beta. Create scoped test/live keys in the dashboard. Test delivery never posts externally. Live platform access requires configured OAuth applications and any required provider approval. All times are RFC 3339. API changes are versioned under /v1. Plans include monthly allowances and a per-minute API rate; read them with GET /usage. Work beyond an allowance is rejected with 429 usage_limit_exceeded and is never charged automatically; do not retry it before details.reset_at. Cached resource/status/usage reads, cancellation, disconnect, webhook disabling and exact post replays do not consume monthly API requests. Fresh publishing-options and comment reads do. Authentication, scope and per-minute limits apply to all requests. Server errors (5xx) do not count toward the API request allowance. OAuth app grants also use this REST contract; access tokens must be bound to the exact REST resource https://castrook.com/api/v1. MCP has its own resource https://castrook.com/mcp. The grants are workspace-, mode- and scope-bound; credentials cannot cross these resources.

post.summary: Record account-owner acceptance for YouTube performance
post.description: Requires accounts:write and a connected YouTube account. Submit only after the account owner expressly accepts the current Castrook privacy policy at /privacy. Never infer consent from an old OAuth grant or submit on their behalf without authorization. The server timestamps the receipt and binds it to the connection authorization revision; reconnection requires new acceptance. Legacy YouTube metrics are redacted and external refresh is blocked until acceptance. Hosted YouTube onboarding records acceptance during its explicit legal step. Other platforms return 409 analytics_consent_not_required. Recovery operation, exempt from monthly API usage.

post.summary: Create a hosted customer connection link
post.description: Requires accounts:write and a profile in the same mode. Returns one private connection URL. The customer connects eligible accounts without accessing your dashboard or API key. Live connections use OAuth; test connections simulate authorization. Embed only when embed_origin is configured. Sessions are browser-bound and checked again at callback; expiry or revocation prevents new authorization.

patch.summary: Move an account to a customer profile
patch.description: Requires accounts:write. Assigns a profile in the same workspace and mode; null removes its assignment. Returns 409 while accepted posts are pending for this account. Existing historical posts retain their recorded customer association.

delete.description: Requires accounts:write. Disables the connection. For YouTube, requests Google authorization revocation and purges associated stored API data; Google revocation can affect other Castrook connections under the same authorization. Provider failures are retried with bounded encrypted credential retention. An already-accepted upload may still finish. Does not delete published videos or comments. Reconnection can be temporarily blocked while revocation and cleanup finish.

get.description: Requires accounts:read. TikTok accounts only; other platforms return 422 publishing_options_unavailable. Fetch before rendering the creator consent flow. Display the creator nickname, require manual privacy selection without a default, and respect disabled interactions and maximum duration. Test accounts return deterministic settings; live accounts query TikTok using the connected account. These controls may change before delivery, when Castrook validates them again.
Requires posts:read. Cursor-paginated results, scoped to key mode.

post.description: Requires posts:write. Returns acceptance, not final publication. Poll GET /posts/{id} or use webhooks. Every destination has independent status. Test mode simulates delivery without publishing. Request JSON is limited to 64 KiB. Live TikTok supports one video or up to 35 images; Instagram supports one image/Reel, ordered carousels of up to 10 images/videos, and one-image/video Stories for Business accounts; Facebook supports text, up to 10 feed photos, one video/Reel or one-image/video Story; YouTube requires one video and made_for_kids. Mixed TikTok/Facebook media is rejected. Stories require an empty caption because these APIs do not overlay text. Omitted format retains existing per-platform defaults. All chosen destination content is validated before queueing; each account receives only its own overrides. TikTok API clients must provide the required creator-facing preview, current settings, commercial disclosures and explicit approval before submitting each post. Do not use scheduled execution as permission for unreviewed content. Each destination reserves one publication from the allowance of the period it is scheduled for (429 usage_limit_exceeded when none remain); the first provider write atomically claims the current period and a published destination consumes that claim even if completion crosses a reset, a failed or canceled destination releases it, and an uncertain delivery stays reserved until reconciled. A new accepted post consumes one API request atomically; an exact idempotent replay consumes no additional API request or publication, including at the monthly cap. Live posts return 409 account_capacity_exceeded while the workspace has more connected live accounts than its plan allows. Destinations are rechecked before delivery starts and fail with account_capacity_exceeded or usage_limit_exceeded if the workspace became ineligible.

post.description: Requires media:write. Reserve capacity and receive a short-lived private PUT ticket, valid for up to 15 minutes. Upload the exact file bytes with returned headers directly to storage; never send your API key there. Then call completion. Videos are limited to 128 MiB; still images must also fit the completion bounds of 20 MiB and 24 megapixels. Live uploads count new bytes once; a managed asset reused across destinations is not charged again. Test-mode media is isolated from live assets.

get.description: Requires media:read. A ready asset can be used through media_items.asset_id. Unreferenced ready assets expire after 30 days; accepted scheduled work pins assets through terminal delivery, followed by at least a seven-day recovery window. Cached recovery read, exempt from monthly API usage.

delete.description: Requires media:write. Returns 409 media_in_use while an accepted post references the asset. Deletion is asynchronous; a deleting asset is no longer usable. Recovery operation, exempt from monthly API usage.

post.summary: Verify and freeze an uploaded file
post.description: Requires media:write. No request body is needed. Verifies uploaded size, media type, SHA-256 and decodable image/video metadata, then freezes verified bytes at a separate immutable key. Still images must fully decode within 20 MiB and 24 megapixels; animated images are unsupported. A pending ticket is not publishable. Completion is safe to repeat once ready, does not charge twice, and remains available after the monthly API allowance is used. Unsupported or malformed files fail with 422; checksum/type/size mismatches never become ready assets.

get.description: Requires analytics:read. Filters select the post creation range; values are lifetime snapshots, not engagement earned during that range. Defaults to the last 30 UTC days, bounded to one year. Cached recovery read, exempt from monthly API usage. Missing metrics stay unavailable, not zero; test-mode counters are explicitly simulated. Permissions, format or visibility can limit availability. YouTube API data is redacted after disconnect/revocation or expiry. Live YouTube performance also requires explicit current account-owner privacy acceptance; otherwise rows report privacy_consent_required and no statistics are fetched. See POST /accounts/{id}/analytics-consent.

post.description: Requires analytics:write. Refreshes available published destinations using current granted access. Within the five-minute cooldown it returns cached:true; an active refresh lease returns 409. Fresh refreshes are metered API operations. Provider failure preserves the last successful snapshot and marks refresh_error; it never fabricates counts. Missing scopes or unsupported metrics are represented as unavailable. Scheduled refreshes are bounded.

get.summary: List comments for a published destination
get.description: Requires comments:read. Live requests also count toward the monthly comment request allowance. post_id is a Castrook post ID; account_id identifies its published destination. Live results contain up to 50 top-level comments per page. List a comment before replying to it. TikTok general comment management is not available via Content Posting API. YouTube requires active authorization and a current video record; revoked access, provider deletion, unrefreshable expired records, private videos, and disabled comments can prevent access.

post.description: Requires comments:write. Live requests also count toward the monthly comment request allowance. A real reply is sent to the connected platform. Reply text is trimmed. Do not blindly retry on ambiguous network failures.

get.description: Any active key, without an additional scope, or a dashboard session. Reports the key mode only: live keys see live allowances; test keys see the separate test allowances. Does not consume the monthly API allowance; authentication, scope and per-minute limits still apply. used counts completed work; reserved holds one publication per accepted destination not yet published, in the period it is scheduled for; remaining is max(0, limit - used - reserved). Metrics that do not apply to test mode are null.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute: the plan rate for API keys (per workspace and mode), or the dashboard session rate.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current one-minute window.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time, in seconds, when the current one-minute window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. For usage_limit_exceeded, the time until the allowance resets.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist in this workspace

Conflict.description: Idempotency conflict, invalid state transition, or an account limit: account_limit_reached (connecting beyond the plan, or beyond 10 test accounts) or account_capacity_exceeded (the workspace has more connected live accounts than its plan allows; new live publications are blocked until accounts are disconnected or the plan is upgraded; nothing is deleted).

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limit_exceeded: the per-minute rate was reached; retry after Retry-After. usage_limit_exceeded: a monthly allowance is used; this request accepted no new work; previously accepted work remains recoverable; do not retry a blocked new operation before details.reset_at. platform_rate_limited: the connected platform throttled the request.
